title: A categorical equivalence for monadic algebras of first-order substructural logics motivated by Kalman's construction
summary: The category $\mathbb{DRDL'}$, whose objects are c-differential residuated distributive lattices that satisfy the condition $\mathbf{CK}$, is the image of the category $\mathbb{RDL}$, whose objects are residuated distributive lattices, under the categorical equivalence (Kalman functor) $\mathbf{K}$. The main goal of this paper is to lift this equivalence $\mathbf{K}$ to the category $\mathbb{MRDL}$, whose objects are monadic residuated distributive lattices, and the category $\mathbb{MDRDL'}$, whose objects are pairs formed by an object of $\mathbb{DRDL'}$ and a center universal quantifier.…
